components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.8rem 1.4rem; background: var(--color-cyan, #0e7490); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-sky, #0369a1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cyan, #0e7490); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Alert Button
components.css: .ds-btn-alert { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.8rem 1.4rem; background: var(--color-alert, #c81e1e); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-alert:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-alert:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-alert, #c81e1e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hero Button
components.css: .ds-btn-hero { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.8rem 1.4rem; background: #fff; color: var(--color-frost, #183044); border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-hero:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-hero:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Product Tile
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #c9d7e1); background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius-tile, 1.15rem); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06); text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-tile:hover { border-color: var(--color-cyan, #0e7490); box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-tile-media { display: block; aspect-ratio: 1; background: var(--color-plate, #d5e2eb); } .ds-tile-label { display: flex; min-height: 3.25rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-frost, #183044); }

components.name: Wordmark Nav
components.description: Sabit çubuk, wordmark, Teklif al, Saha işlerimiz.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; height: 4.25rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line, #c9d7e1); color: var(--color-frost, #183044); font-size: var(--text-nav, 0.95rem); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav strong { font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-nav span { font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-mute, #3d5363); } .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.8rem 1.4rem; background: var(--color-cyan, #0e7490); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Measure Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-frost, #183044); } .ds-input { border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #c9d7e1); background: var(--color-obsidian, #eef3f7); border-radius: var(--radius-soft, 0.9rem); padding: 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; caret-color: var(--color-cyan, #0e7490); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cyan, #0e7490); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field Works Shot
components.description: Saha galerisi karesi; hover’da renk ve büyüme.
components.css: .ds-works-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10.5rem; grid-template-rows: 13rem; transition: grid-template-columns 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), grid-template-rows 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-works-item:is(:hover, :focus-within) { grid-template-columns: 14rem; grid-template-rows: 17.5rem; } .ds-works-shot { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-soft, 0.9rem); background: var(--color-plate, #d5e2eb); cursor: pointer; filter: grayscale(1) brightness(0.78); transition: filter 220ms ease, box-shadow 220ms ease; } .ds-works-item:is(:hover, :focus-within) .ds-works-shot { filter: none; box-shadow: 0 14px 32px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-frost, #183044) 22%, transparent); } .ds-works-shot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cyan, #0e7490); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Açık, gündüz işletme ışığında okunan bir vitrin. Zemin soğuk kâğıt; yazı don laciverti. Cyan yalnız kapı ve vurgu için. Üst kapak buzdan bir sahne; altı sakin, halkın okuduğu bir katalog. Ana sayfa sırası: kapak → hakkımızda → ürünler → servis → saha işlerimiz → iletişim.
keyCharacteristics: IBM Plex Sans gövde ve başlık; Caveat yalnız slogan
Eyebrow / kicker yok; başlık kendi ağırlığını taşır
Gerçek ürün / saha görselleri; yoksa dürüst yer tutucu
Saha işlerimiz: gri kayan galeri, hover büyüme, lightbox

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cyan bir ekranın en fazla onda biridir. Acil kırmızı yalnız arıza kapısındadır.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Başlığın üstüne küçük uppercase etiket konmaz.

dos: Do görselsiz yerde yer tutucu bırak.
donts: Don't üretim, ödül veya sertifika uydur.
Don't Inter, mor gradyan veya iç içe kart kullan.
